paper.title: Graph-Transformer-based Surrogate Model for Accelerated Converter Circuit Topology Design

source_search.scope: Author PDF and institutional publication record were inspected; public title/author/GitHub searches did not locate a verifiable original code release. ZeroSim's public repository does not include its GTN comparison implementation.
source_search.excluded_unrelated_repository: GiantCarl/GTSM is a solid-mechanics surrogate by different authors and is not this GTN.

retained_mechanisms: Separate multihead attention over connected neighbors and each incident minimum-basis circuit loop (paper equations 1, 2, 3).
Learned candidate-weighted summation over neighbor and loop messages (paper equation 4).
Repeated independently parameterized GTN layers with ReLU activation.
Mean pooling and the original two-hidden-layer regression head with widths 64 and 16.

training_integration.batch: Static gtn_loop_membership_by_pin [B,P,L], kept by design_input_pin; no CPU loop discovery in prepared train/eval batches
training_integration.epoch: Both branches enabled from epoch one; original paper warmup schedule is not implemented in this pin adapter
training_integration.fallback: Standalone pin batches have topology-only owner/net/mask CPU caching; production training prepares resident masks first

pin_adaptation.learned_nodes: Observed terminals and named external ports
pin_adaptation.loop_graph: Original physical owner-device/net bipartite incidence recovered from pin_to_device and pin_net_index; no loops from pin cliques
pin_adaptation.loop_projection: Terminal endpoints whose physical owner AND electrical net are on the physical cycle. External circuit ports are never owner devices.
pin_adaptation.decoder: Original mean pooling/64/16 MLP operates on pin memory
pin_adaptation.cpu_scope: Topology cycle discovery is preprocessing, cached as resident gtn_loop_membership_by_pin; attention and optimization run on selected Torch device
pin_adaptation.schedule: Both branches enabled from epoch 1 to match controlled-budget protocol; no original 450/700 warmup claim
